agree.reason: A salon owner who pays her cousin $600 a year sees $199 a month and finds no reason on the page to give up a cheaper arrangement she likes, so she probably won't book.

honest.reason: Several claims go beyond the brief: 'no add-on fees', sales tax 'filed on time' and 'many salons are closed then too' are all invented, and 'almost always' makes 3 missed closes in 12 months sound better than it is.

works_the_facts.reason: Nothing is calculated: the page never gives the annual cost ($2,388), never sets it against the $800 savings, and never turns 29 of 31 clients staying or 9 of 31 clients saving money into a rate.

right_comparison.reason: The only alternative described is a 'shoebox', which misrepresents a reader whose books already get done every year at tax time by someone she trusts.

qualification.reason: Disclosing the 3 missed closes and saying the savings aren't guaranteed is honest, but neither hedge tells the reader what happens when the 10th is missed or gives a figure she could check for her own salon.

objections.reason: The page answers questions about deadlines, client retention and staffing, but never takes on her real objection: why she should pay about four times what her cousin charges.

fit.reason: At roughly 360 words with a booking button at the end, it matches the length and form the brief asked for.
